input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including url. The platform provides capabilities for rest exception handler. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to create and manage url records, so that I can track and organize url data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to use rest exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Developer, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
